messages:
sophie: Quick heads up — PartnerCo is sending two people tomorrow, 10am arrival. Do we have a preferred visitor seat area and badge plan?
jenna: @sophie I can handle check-in at the desk. We'll need their full names and company for pre-registration.
michelle: I can print guest badges and hold any packages for them. Send names here and I'll tag them 'guest' in the mailroom system. :white_check_mark:
owen: For seating, 4th-floor huddle near conference B usually works for short visits. It's quieter and has chairs for three.
karan: If they want to pair with engineers, the east hot-desk rows by the windows are good. FYI those desks are free after 9:30.
sophie: Names are Maya Li and Jonah Park. They might drop off a small box with swag before 9 — can the mailroom hold it?
michelle: Yep, I'll note it. Please ask delivery to mark recipient as 'Maya Li / Jonah Park - PartnerCo' so it's easy to find.
front-desk-bot: Reminder: Temporary visitor Wi-Fi credentials will be issued at check-in. Access expires at 5:00 PM local time.
jenna: @sophie I'll have two paper badges and lanyards ready. If they need a keycard for the 4th floor I'll request a temporary one — does PartnerCo need secure room access?
sophie: No secure access needed — just general seating and wifi. No need for keycards.
lunchbot: Quick poll: do we want to offer them lunch? :sandwich: 
michelle: I can order two lunches if you want — prefer sandwiches or salads?
owen: Sandwiches are fine. Also suggest a short desk tour (5–10 min) after intro.
karan: I'll be around and can introduce the infra folks.
sophie: Awesome, thanks everyone. @michelle please hold the package and order lunch. @jenna appreciate you covering check-in. See you tomorrow — :pray:
front-desk-bot: Guest badges printed: 2. Mail item logged: 1 package held under 'Maya Li'.
michelle: Logged the package and ordered 2 turkey sandwiches. ETA 11:45.
jenna: Check-in notes added to calendar invite. All set.
sophie: Perfect — closing the loop. Thanks!
